subject: physics

hotspots.label: Velocity Arrow
hotspots.description: The arrow attached to the car: same length at constant speed, but it keeps rotating to point which way the car heads.
hotspots.positionHint: An arrow beam from the car's roof, sweeping as the car drives the loop.
hotspots.function: Shows speed as arrow length and direction as arrow heading together.

hotspots.label: Speedometer Value
hotspots.description: The plain speed number (e.g. 3 m/s) with no direction — the scalar part velocity borrows from speed.
hotspots.positionHint: A speedometer dial plate on a post next to the track.
hotspots.function: Displays the directionless speed that velocity builds on.

hotspots.label: Direction Labels
hotspots.description: A compass ring around the track names every heading (N, S, E, W) so the arrow's direction can be spoken aloud.
hotspots.positionHint: Raised letters printed on the ring at the track edge.
hotspots.function: Names the direction part of each velocity vector.

hotspots.label: Reverse Arrow
hotspots.description: When the car reverses, the arrow flips 180° — a full direction change that shows velocity shifting while speed stays put.
hotspots.positionHint: A ghost arrow and label visible in reverse mode.
hotspots.function: Illustrates how reversing the direction flips the velocity vector.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white paper background, soft vignette, no floor grid, no props beyond the track. A circular loop on a warm-grey mat, tiny amber car, its velocity arrow a bright coral lever, one floating speedometer plate, and compass letters on the rim. Saturated color on arrow + hotspot dots only. Neutral studio light, no bloom, no emissive
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness, metallic=0. Loop: warm cafe ring (roughness ~0.65) with a dashed grip lane. Car: amber body (roughness ~0.45). Arrow: coral matte prism (roughness ~0.4) with cone head. Dial: warm paper face with ink ticks. All readouts runtime app layer; the GLB ships cleanly static.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: velocity as speed-with-direction demonstrated on a circular loop; constant speed, ever-turning velocity.

GEOMETRY: circular track radius ~1.4 on y=0, an outer compass ring with letters at 4 cardinal points. A small car sits on the track riding an arrow asset that pivots to the heading. A speed dial floats on a thin post (-0.8,0.8,0.35).

INTERACTION: the app moves the car at constant speed and rotates the arrow to the tangent heading; Reverse mode flips the arrow; the loop repeats showing the same speed with rotating velocity.

LAYERS: track+car; arrow; dial; ring labels.

NAMED NODES: LoopTrack, CompassRing, CarBody, VelocityArrow, SpeedDial, GhostArrow. 6-10k tris.
